Hotcell research workers (`src/tools/hotcell-worker.ts`) currently run `npm ci` and `node --import tsx src/index.tsx` inside a clone of the user's repository, which only works when that repository is Autopilot itself. Change the worker runtime so each cell installs `autopilot-ai@<coordinator version>` into `/tmp/autopilot-worker` with `--omit=optional` and runs that binary from the repo root; `KIMIFLARE_WORKER_PACKAGE` overrides the npm spec (validated and shell-quoted). Run checkout and install as a separate setup step with its own timeout (`KIMIFLARE_WORKER_SETUP_TIMEOUT_MS`, default 5 minutes) so setup failure or timeout is reported distinctly and research never starts after a failed setup. Require `HEAD` to be on a remote-tracking branch (checked locally, no network) and fail before creating a cell with a message telling the user to `git push` otherwise.

The regression test(s) for this change are already in the worktree: `src/tools/hotcell-worker.test.ts`. Read them to see the exact API and behaviour expected, then implement the change so they pass. Do not modify the test files; they are restored before verification. Run the tests with `npx tsx --test src/tools/hotcell-worker.test.ts` and `npm run typecheck` before you finish.
